name: Dermalinfusion

lead: Dermalinfusion pairs skin exfoliation with serum infusion in one pass. It is offered as a facial treatment.
The only publication found examined it alongside a peptide for dark marks after inflammation in darker skin.

paras: A handheld tip is described as exfoliating while delivering a serum to the skin.
No safety information was available in the sources reviewed.

studies.title: Combined topical delivery and dermalinfusion of decapeptide-12 accelerates resolution of post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation in skin of color.
studies.source: Journal of drugs in dermatology : JDD

lead: Dermalinfusion is a branded aesthetic procedure that combines a form of exfoliation with simultaneous serum infusion through a handheld tip. Evidence found is limited to one 2014 Journal of Drugs in Dermatology study that combined topical delivery with dermalinfusion of decapeptide-12 to treat post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation in skin of color.[1]

paras: A 2014 study reported on combined topical delivery and dermalinfusion of decapeptide-12 for resolving post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation in skin of color.[1] No other studies were found.
